announcements.title: Bethelhem Youth Academy Academic Council Resolution
announcements.content: All physical classes will compile evaluations on June 15th for the Quarter 4 consolidation check. Double session parent gates open at 3:30 PM.

announcements.title: Quarterly Teacher In-Service Briefing
announcements.content: Standard portal training for uploading student attendance modules and tracking double afternoon roll logs is scheduled for next Saturday.

announcements.title: Security Gate Log Consolidation
announcements.content: To support safety checks, students must wear their standardized barcode badges at arrival (morning session check-in) and departure.

announcements.title: Grade 8 National Assessment Preparations
announcements.content: Junior High student cohorts will hold mandatory mock subject exams in Mathematics, General Science, and English on Tuesdays.
